button.name: DtButton
button.description: A clickable button with multiple variants and sizes

input.name: DtInput
input.description: Text input with 2 variants, 4 sizes, validation states, optional floating label, clearable. Plus DtPhoneInput (UZ + 4 neighbors) and DtPaymentInput (card-brand detection).

card.name: DtCard
card.description: A container card with header, content, and footer sections

badge.name: DtBadge
badge.description: A small status indicator with multiple variants

badge-group.name: DtBadgeGroup
badge-group.description: Inline announcement badge: pill or modern style, leading or trailing layout, five colors, two sizes, optional link.

avatar.name: DtAvatar
avatar.description: User avatar with image, initials, or icon fallback. Six sizes, optional status indicator, label-group composition, stacked group, and add-button.

dialog.name: DtDialog
dialog.description: Modal dialog with overlay, header, content, and footer

select.name: DtSelect
select.description: Custom dropdown select with search and keyboard navigation

dropdown-menu.name: DtDropdownMenu
dropdown-menu.description: Floating menu with items, separators, labels, groups, checkbox/radio items, and nested submenus. Bring your own trigger via asChild.

toggle.name: DtToggle
toggle.description: Switch toggle with 3 sizes and active/disabled states

checkbox.name: DtCheckbox
checkbox.description: Checkbox with label, 3 sizes, and checked/disabled states

radio.name: DtRadio
radio.description: Radio button with label, 3 sizes, and animated selection dot

data-table.name: DtDataTable
data-table.description: Data table with column config, slot-based cells, loading and empty states

pagination.name: DtPagination
pagination.description: Page navigation with prev/next arrows and numbered buttons

tab-switcher.name: DtTabSwitcher
tab-switcher.description: Animated tab bar with FLIP indicator for status filtering

search-toolbar.name: DtSearchToolbar
search-toolbar.description: Search input with optional action button for list pages

status-badge.name: DtStatusBadge
status-badge.description: Color-coded status pill for active/inactive/moderation states

layout.name: DtLayout
layout.description: App shell layout with sidebar, header, modules modal, profile modal, page view, and divider
